name: Rapac Energy Ltd.
summary: Rapac Energy Ltd. engages in the development, construction, and operation of energy facilities. It specializes in large-scale renewable energy initiatives, transmitted over ultra-high voltage (UHV), as well as ground-mounted photovoltaic projects and dual-use of low and high voltage. The company was founded by Itai Hagay and Oded Nezer in 2021 and is headquartered in Modiin, Israel.
